'''ATS-0021''' was a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. ATS-0021 was assigned to the [[Defiance Task Force]] and carried a cargo of medical supplies.
